title: Zero DAW
summary: Pocket music studio: 17 synth plugins, 184 sounds, USB MIDI and HDMI.
description:
*** Mouse and HDMI output recommended ***

Zero DAW turns the M5Stack CardputerZero into a complete pattern-based music studio. Program beats on the channel rack, write melodies in the piano roll, arrange songs in the playlist and mix with reverb, delay and drive, all from the keyboard.

It comes with 17 instrument plugins, each with its own faceplate and live waveform. They include Acid303 with slide and accent, SuperSaw, FM, wavetable, formant vocals, a string machine, additive, CZ-style phase distortion, organ, E-piano, physical strings and bells, chiptune, a drum synth and a sampler. That's 184 sounds ready to play, and you can add your own.

Plug in a USB MIDI keyboard to play and record live, with knobs for cutoff, resonance and more. Zero DAW can also sync to MIDI clock or drive your hardware synths. Plug in HDMI and you get the Studio View on your TV, with the built-in screen becoming a live companion display. Export your tracks to WAV. Eight demo songs show what it can do, from acid house and drum & bass to trap, funk, ambient and chiptune.

Features

- Channel rack step sequencer, piano roll, 8-track playlist, 16-channel mixer.
- 17 instrument plugins with their own faceplates and live waveforms: TriOsc, FM Zero, DrumSynth, Sampler, Plucker, SuperSaw, Organ, E-Piano, Acid303, ChipTune, Modal, Wavetron, VoxBox, Ensemble, Additron, PD-Zero, MIDI Out.
- 184 built-in sounds, all synthesised on the device - add your own presets and WAV samples, or record from the microphone.
- USB MIDI keyboards and controllers: play, record, knobs for cutoff, resonance, attack and more; MIDI clock in and out.
- HDMI Studio View: rack, playlist, piano roll and plugins side by side on your monitor, with a live companion display on the built-in screen.
- Reverb, delay, drive, tone and a master limiter.
- Export songs to WAV.
- Eight demo songs: Acid Zero, Night Drive, Chip Dreams, Lo-Fi Keys, Jungle Zero, Trap 808, Vox Funk, Ambient Glass.
